e: Four independent fellowships in Teruel, Spain, tied to J-PAS, J-PLUS, J-VAR and/or ARRAKIHS, with dual supervision and secondments. Open to all nationalities, but the MSCA mobility rule applies (no more than 12 of the last 36 months in Spain).
f: Centro de Estudios de Física del Cosmos de Aragón (CEFCA)
n: CEFCA: J-TRAIN MSCA COFUND Postdoctoral Fellowships in Astrophysics and Cosmology
